name: Serapion of Alexandria
bio: Serapion of Alexandria is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 1st century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Wreath of Philippus, the Garland compiled in the first century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 400).

poems.title: Book VII, 400
poems.author: Serapion of Alexandria
poems.text: This bone is that of some man who laboured much. Either wast thou a merchant or a fisher in the blind, uncertain sea. ‘Tell to mortals that eagerly pursuing other hopes we all rest at the end in the haven of such a hope.
